args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy of v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: From the deployment history, v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 (seq 3) was unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was only a staging release.

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` with v2.3.0 now active in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure and the rollback action taken.
